name: md-property-tax
description: Calculate Moldova's 2026 local immovable-property and land taxes and prepare the applicable BIJ17, unified-return or individual-notice workflow. Establish the liable owner or user, cadastral valuation status, locality, ownership dates, land category and fertility index before selecting a base and rate. Covers evaluated buildings and land, unevaluated property under Law 1056, fractional and undivided ownership, new and transferred objects, exemptions, municipal decisions, IT-park transitions and separate filing/payment cutoffs. Maps the actual BIJ17 main calculation and locality/relief annexes, individual notice fields and public payment entry. Use for annual property tax, land tax, September/March filing or checking a municipal notice. Wealth tax, rental income and disposal gains use their own connected methods.
